```yaml
name: Fuzzing

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  property-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .
        pip install pytest hypothesis
        
    - name: Run property-based tests
      run: |
        make fuzz-property
      timeout-minutes: 2

  atheris-fuzzing:
    needs: property-tests
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.10'
        
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -e .
        pip install atheris
        
    - name: Run Atheris fuzzing
      run: |
        timeout 60s python -m pytest tests/test_fuzz.py -v
      timeout-minutes: 2

    - name: Upload fuzzing artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: fuzzing-results
        path: |
          *.log
          *.txt
```
